classification: synthetic crop-model-v2 missing-profile fail-closed software coverage; not a supported-crop or accuracy benchmark
comparisonType: Structural compatibility checks over a pinned catalog snapshot; no numeric crop output is compared.

syntheticSetupSha256.algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON for syntheticSetup, with recursively sorted keys and no whitespace separators.

acceptanceScope.existingA08Evidence: quality/beta/02A-MODEL-DECISION.md A-08 row records browser summary retention for a missing environment-v2 input case and an unsupported v4 lifecycle case.
acceptanceScope.newCaseLimit: This all-catalog unit test checks support qualification, the preserveStoredSummary policy flag, and replay rejection for missing v2 profiles. It does not claim actual per-record summary retention across all 50 crops; the replayRunToDay API does not accept a summary.

catalogSnapshot.source: src/data/crops.ts symbol cropLibrary, registered against the code SHA above; compare to the coverage rows in quality/beta/evidence/model-coverage.json.

caseTemplate.oneCell: floor cell 0,0 planted with exactly the current catalog crop ID
caseTemplate.startEvent: transplanting for the synthetic input; source-event-domain reasons may also occur and are not used to satisfy the missing-profile metric

soil.source: omitted and interpreted as unknown; test-only sentinel values

caseTemplate.profileConstruction: Call freezeRunModelInputsV2 for one crop with no prior inputs and without cropParametersV2. The existing freezer creates a same-crop-ID explicit parameter record with missing production and root-zone fields; no fallback profile is supplied.

plantCropProductionMissing: initial above-ground dry matter at establishment

requiredReasonTemplates.invalidV2Profile: Crop {cropId}: one or more frozen v2 parameter values are missing, invalid, or unsupported.
requiredReasonTemplates.fungalLifecycle: Crop {cropId}: separate fungus lifecycle is unsupported

caseTemplate.replayAttempt: For each case, call replayRunToDay with a synthetic record id, the matching config, an empty environment series, and a fresh ReplayStateCache. The registered expectation is UnsupportedRunReplayError before any tick. The replay API accepts no stored summary, so this fixture does not claim persisted-summary equality.

registeredMetrics.expected: The unique numeric crop IDs and slugs in cropLibrary exactly equal entriesSortedByCropId, with 50 entries and no duplicate IDs.
registeredMetrics.tolerance: Exact array equality after sorting by cropId; exact unique-ID count.
registeredMetrics.basis: The software check is pinned to a named catalog snapshot rather than an unversioned dynamic crop count.

registeredMetrics.expected: For each catalog entry, RunConfig planting crop ID, frozen crops[0].id, and cropParameters[0].cropId match exactly. Production and rootZone statuses are unsupported; each missing array exactly matches the lifecycle-specific registered fields; frozen qualification is unsupported.
registeredMetrics.tolerance: Exact crop-ID equality, status equality, and missing-field array equality.
registeredMetrics.basis: Prevent a wrong-crop or missing-snapshot case from masquerading as the registered crop's missing v2 profile.

registeredMetrics.expected: For every matching v2 config and frozen input, inspectRunModelSupport returns model crop-model-v2, status unsupported, canReplay false, and preserveStoredSummary true. Its reasons include requiredReasonTemplates.invalidV2Profile with {cropId} replaced by that crop ID.
registeredMetrics.tolerance: Exact structural fields and exact interpolated reason template. Other source-thermal/start-event reasons may also appear; the full reasons array is not compared because 41 crops lack a thermal table entry and fungi have a separate lifecycle reason.
registeredMetrics.basis: Fail-closed historical replay qualification. The preserveStoredSummary field is a policy signal, not an assertion that this test executed or proved actual record-summary retention.

registeredMetrics.expected: Each crop-specific replayRunToDay call throws UnsupportedRunReplayError whose reasons include requiredReasonTemplates.invalidV2Profile with {cropId} replaced by that crop ID; no unsupported state is returned.
registeredMetrics.tolerance: Exact exception class and exact interpolated reason template; the environment series is empty. This asserts replay rejection, not internal tick instrumentation.
registeredMetrics.basis: The current replay API checks persisted support before creating or advancing state; this fixture records only the observable exception and absence of a returned state.

registeredMetrics.expected: For crop IDs 48, 49, and 50, the frozen parameter lifecycle is fungus and the qualification reasons include requiredReasonTemplates.fungalLifecycle with {cropId} replaced by that crop ID.
registeredMetrics.tolerance: Exact lifecycle string and exact crop-associated reason for those three IDs.
registeredMetrics.basis: Do not map fungal catalog entries to the plant lifecycle to obtain a uniform test pass.

acceptanceBoundary: If approved and passed, this closes only a bounded synthetic software fail-closed subcase for the pinned 50-crop catalog snapshot: profile identity, explicit production/root-zone missing fields, support qualification, preserved-summary policy flag, and replay rejection. It does not establish a supported v2 profile for any crop, all-catalog simulator support, actual summary retention for every crop, crop accuracy, biological validity, measured/reference agreement, or overall A-08/02A acceptance.
